title: coreopsis grandiflora var. saxicola
intro: Coreopsis grandiflora var. saxicola, commonly known as Rocky Mountain tickseed, is a perennial plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae) native to the western United States. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Rocky Mountain tickseed include its ability to reduce fever, treat wounds, and alleviate digestive issues. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic uses.
